resources.string: Live TV: connect a Tvheadend server or network tuner (optional)
Favourites: start with the first 8 channels (OK)
Connect Live TV first, then the channels can be chosen

Android picks the screensaver in its own settings: Settings → Device preferences → Screen saver → Advanced TV Home screensaver.

Or from a computer, with USB or network debugging on:
adb shell settings put secure screensaver_components io.github.ksfikas.tvhome/.Screensaver
